title: Poetry Contest
body:
The Task Force runs a PBB CAG Poetry Contest. Full rules, deadlines, and prize details aren't published online yet — contact the Task Force directly for current contest information:

- Phone: (989) 763-4423
- Mailing address: P.O. Box 172, St. Louis, MI 48880

*The contest flyer and full submission details should be added here once gathered from the organization — this page is a placeholder for that follow-up, not a final migration.*
